places.name: Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove
places.note: At dawn Soupy Jones arrives and is hired; Gus's pigs turn up; Augustus hitches the mule wagon while Call culls the remuda.
places.location_hint: near the herd, roughly two miles or a bit more outside Lonesome Dove in the chaparral, within sight of the river toward Mexico

places.name: Jake and Lorena's camp near Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus finds Lorena burning breakfast and Jake nursing a mesquite thorn in his swollen thumb amid a scattered camp.
places.location_hint: about half a mile from the Hat Creek main camp and two miles from Lonesome Dove, on stony ground

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus pries his sign off the corral fence, consoles a despairing Xavier, and leaves with Lippy, who signs on to the drive.
places.location_hint: tiny south Texas border town of about ten buildings, across chaparral flats from the herd camp

places.name: Bastrop
places.note: Soupy has just come from this small town, where his wife died.

places.name: Stone House
places.note: Pea recalls Indians firing the grass there and running off the horses.
places.location_hint: site of an old Ranger fight, apparently near the Brazos in north-central Texas

places.name: Powder River
places.note: Augustus teases that most of the hands will drown before reaching it.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Augustus warns Lippy he might drown in it.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Bolivar fears never seeing his village and daughters across the river again if he goes north.

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Bolivar gazes across it toward his home village.

places.name: Alabama
places.note: Augustus thinks of Lorena as a young prostitute from there.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Augustus thinks Lorena's resolve may get her there; Xavier says he would have taken her.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Augustus suggests Xavier go there to recruit a new prostitute.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus drank there against the heat and feels lucky to be leaving it alive.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus expects to drink against the cold there; tells Lippy that's where he's headed.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove
groups.hint: preparing to start the herd north

groups.label: Augustus and Lippy
groups.hint: in the wagon, just leaving town across the chaparral flats toward the herd

groups.label: Jake and Lorena
groups.at: Jake and Lorena's camp near Lonesome Dove
groups.hint: about to pack and leave their camp half a mile from the herd
